themes.label: Fragmentary
themes.rationale: The text contains partial words and brackets indicating missing letters, such as 'αρδι' and 'αὐ[τῶ]ν'.

rationale: This inscription from Hellenistic Babylon appears to be an administrative record or account. It lists two primary individuals—Ballaros (a name of likely local or Iranian origin) and Artemon (a Greek name)—alongside groups of subordinates ('those under him/them'). The inclusion of the Greek numeral σμθ (249) and other alphanumeric strings suggests it served as a ledger for personnel management or resource distribution within the Seleucid administration.
